segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Year after year, Hannah went to the house of the LORD and came away with an empty lap.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The other wife mocked her for it.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: One year at Shiloh, Hannah slipped to the door of the tabernacle and prayed with a voice no one could hear — only her lips moved. This is what she said.

segments.speaker: woman
segments.text: O LORD of hosts, if thou wilt indeed look on the affliction of thine handmaid, and remember me, and not forget thine handmaid,

segments.speaker: woman
segments.text: but wilt give unto thine handmaid a man child, then I will give him unto the LORD all the days of his life.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Just look at me, she was saying. Remember me. Don't forget me. Give me a son — and I will give him back to You for the whole of his life. She asked for the one thing she wanted most, and promised it away in the same breath.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Eli the priest watched her lips move with no sound coming out, and thought she was drunk.

segments.speaker: woman
segments.text: No, my lord, I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit: I have drunk neither wine nor strong drink, but have poured out my soul before the LORD.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: No, my lord, she told him. I haven't been drinking. I'm a woman with a heavy heart, and I've been pouring my soul out to the Lord. She was not ashamed of the prayer. She just wanted him to know what he was looking at.

segments.speaker: scripture
segments.text: Go in peace: and the God of Israel grant thee thy petition that thou hast asked of him.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Go in peace, Eli said — and may the God of Israel give you the very thing you asked for. She went away, and her face was no longer sad. The LORD remembered her.

segments.speaker: woman
segments.text: Because I have asked him of the LORD.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: A boy was born, and she named him Samuel — because I asked God for him. Every time anyone said that child's name, they were saying it again: I asked, and He heard.

segments.speaker: woman
segments.text: Therefore also I have lent him to the LORD; as long as he liveth he shall be lent to the LORD.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: She kept her word. When he was weaned, she brought him to the house of the LORD and left him there to serve.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Hannah prayed the prayer no one else could hear, and God answered. Your quiet prayers are heard too.
